_note: AUTHORED. fallback, nesting, a11y, responsive, capabilities and tokenRoles are owner decisions of 2026-10-23 (DEC-080); a11y and responsive state only what the source does. tokenRoles is empty: Field has no component-token layer.

hiddenProps.id: DOM id wiring; Field generates one with useId when it is absent, and the protocol carries no DOM ids.

a11y.label: The label's htmlFor is the control's id; the control receives id, invalid, disabled, aria-describedby and aria-required.
a11y.describedBy: aria-describedby points at the error text when there is an error, otherwise at the help text.
a11y.error: Error text is role=alert, with an icon so the error is not colour alone.
